QuestInfo.name: The Key to Lynn's Destiny
QuestInfo.0:
The familiar power leads you to the memory of the past life. 
You are no longer confused. That memory is just another part of you.
QuestInfo.1: You saw yourself as an elderly woman in Gaia's embrace.
QuestInfo.2:
Through your memories, you visited another past life.
You were an old woman in a raging blizzard, but you found warmth in Gaia's voice.

...And, in another voice, you felt #rdeep cold#k.
